opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Ryanair, search for flights from {origin} to {destination} for {departure_date} (and optionally {return_date}), with {adults} passengers and an optional {promo_code}, then select the outbound and return flights.
steps: Open the Ryanair flights search form
Set trip type to Return trip or One way
Click From and choose the origin country and airport (or type the city)
Click To and choose the destination country and airport (or type the city)
Open the Depart calendar, go to the right month and click the departure day
If it's a return trip, open the Return calendar and click the return day
Open Passengers, set the number of adults and click Done
Optionally click Apply promo code and type the code
Click Search
On the results page, click Select for the outbound flight, then for the return flight
Review the fare options

instances.values: Dublin -> Athens, return trip, Sun 2 Apr - Wed 5 Apr, 1 adult; then selected FR4518 and FR4519
Dublin -> Malta, one way, Sat 22 Apr, 2 adults
Tel Aviv -> Venice Treviso, return trip, Tue 9 May - Tue 16 May, 1 adult; then selected FR912 and FR911
Dublin -> Paris Beauvais, return trip, Wed 26 Apr - Tue 2 May, 2 adults, promo code 1000001

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search for {destination_or_attraction} on {date}, optionally apply filters and sorting, open {attraction}, pick the date and the ticket quantities, and continue.
steps: Click Attractions in the Booking.com navigation
Type the destination or attraction (or pick a region tab and a city tile)
Open Select your dates, go to the right month and click the date
Click Search
Optionally check filters (Free cancellation, City, Category) and choose a sort tab (Most popular)
Open the chosen attraction (See availability)
Pick the date in the ticket calendar
Set the number of adult, child and infant tickets with the +/- buttons
Click Next

instances.values: Aquarium of Paris, 5 May 2023; opened the attraction and adjusted ticket counts
Asia -> Kyoto, 25 May 2023, filters Free cancellation + Kyoto + Tours, sorted Most popular; Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour, 2 adults + 1 infant, Next

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant availability notify setup
opportunities.description: On Resy, search for {restaurant_query}, open {restaurant}, optionally set the {date} and {guests}, and set a Notify alert for the {meal_period} with an optional preferred time window.
steps: Type the restaurant name or cuisine into the Resy search box
Click the matching restaurant in the suggestions
Optionally open the Date picker and choose the date
Optionally choose the number of guests
Click Notify for the meal period you want (Lunch or Dinner)
Optionally set the preferred start and end time
Click Confirm
